ttm.note: US GAAP basis. Q3 2026 results are furnished on 6-K (Ex.99.3 summary financial statements, Ex.99.1 press release) filed 2026-10-14; period ends Sep 27 2026 (Q3) and Sep 28 2025 (prior). The 6-K balance sheet has no current debt split, no share count, no awards/options, no lease liabilities - see carriedFrom. Cash 8,030.9 + short-term investments 4,704.2 = 12,735.1 matches press release (12,735). Interim dividend EUR 1.88/share payable 2026-11-04 is not accrued. Customer advances (contract liabilities 9,300.6 non-current plus current) are operating. Current debt is null: the summary statements aggregate current liabilities and the earlier 734.2 estimate was not a filed amount. Q3 slides disclose only approximately 2.8 million repurchased shares; no exact period-end outstanding share count, so the June 28 count remains explicitly carried.

notes: Money in EUR millions, US GAAP as reported in 20-F / 6-K (ASML primary basis). Annual filing: 20-F filed 2026-02-25. Latest quarterly 6-K filed 2026-10-14 (Q3 2026).
